name: RockMsg
meaning: Messages handled by Rock_HandleMessage 0x4e3391 (all return 0 in state 6).

name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: Wolf only -> 5 (CTX_PUSH) if height fits and a push axis is allowed

name: MSG_PUSH
meaning: arg Vec3s* delta in/out; returns 1 when handled

name: MSG_LAUNCH
meaning: arg LaunchArc* (only seesaw_LaunchObject 0x4ef3d9) -> state 5. A NULL-arg 0xC would fault in the copy at 0x4e39fa; the bull's NULL-arg 0xC goes only to sheep

name: MSG_CINE_END
meaning: clears GF 0x10000 if state 7; Rock_StartFall in every state except 6 (in state 6 Rock_HandleMessage returns 0 for all messages, 0x4e33a6)

name: MSG_MAILBOX_DELIVERED
meaning: from Mailbox_Deliver: use the LVL03WITHBOX cinematic

name: MSG_QUERY_PUSH_AXIS
meaning: from Wolf 0x48d9f6 (Wolf::SnapHeadingToObject): a PushAxis reply - 0 = free, 1 = X locked, 2 = Z locked (the Rock answers 2 when sideways z pushing is blocked; y is the vertical axis)
